text:
Labs/p53 is a 12-run coarse-grained campaign on the p53 DNA-binding domain, dated 22–23 Aug 2025 in the deliverable folders. The machine-readable contract is findings.json v2.2. The human manuscript (ReadMe.pd) is co-attributed to Gemini, ChatGPT, Grok, and Aaron Spradlin. There is no load-bearing X field note for this campaign in the current compile — it lives on GitHub. Cite the folder and the science contract, not a tweet.

Wild-type also collapses to a compact non-native globule (best RMSD 26.6 Å). The result is mechanism differentiation among misfolded globules, not native p53 folding. Contact-anneal + PhiKan083 improved Y220C from ~25 Å to 18.9 Å inside this force field. That is not a pharmacological proof and not a crystal-structure rescue.

Thesis in the contract

Across the UQCF-GEM campaign, p53-Y220C predominantly fails via a kinetic collapse trap, while p53-R248Q failure is electrostatic in nature. A protocol-level intervention—contact anneal with PhiKan083—achieves meaningful improvement (≤ 20 Å) relative to ~25 Å baselines. The campaign ultimately revealed a force-field limitation in the ligand model.

Twelve-run scoreboard

Two failure modes, one globule

Final RMSD alone does not separate the mutants from wild-type. The mechanistic split is in the diagnostics. R248Q (DNA-contact mutant) loses the salt-bridge network (median 1.0 versus WT 7.0) while collapsing to the same 26.6 Å globule — electrostatic_failure. Y220C (pocket mutant) is diagnosed as a kinetic trap: genetic pocket patches Y220F and L221F do not improve RMSD; a gentler contact-anneal protocol plus the pharmacological chaperone PhiKan083 does, inside this model. The timing sweep says the ligand acts as a thermodynamic stabilizer of the collapsed state, not a kinetic folding guide.

Model: coarse-grained, backbone-centric UQCF-GEM. Terms named in the manuscript: steric, directional H-bond, Ramachandran, Debye–Hückel electrostatics, tunable contact springs.
Protocol: extended coil start unless marked native-start. pH 7.4, ionic strength 150 mM. k_hbond = 16.0, k_contact_springs = 0.05 as the posted sweet spot.
Negative results are first-class: L221F and Y220F fail; the native-start ligand run drifts to 4.0 Å and is filed as a force-field limit, not hidden.
PNG and PDB artifacts in Labs/ are Git LFS pointers in a plain clone. Markdown reports, raw CSVs, and findings.json are ordinary files.

Inside this coarse-grained campaign, R248Q and Y220C reach similar misfolded globules by different routes (electrostatic network loss vs kinetic trap), and a contact-anneal + PhiKan083 protocol improved Y220C RMSD relative to ~25 Å baselines. Not native folding, not a crystal rescue, not a cancer therapy, not a TOE result.

This atlas does not claim that PhiKan083 rescues p53-Y220C in cells, or that UQCF-GEM replaces all-atom MD. The native-start drift is the campaign’s own limit.
